component.name: Studio 1810c
component.summary: Mixer and routing control for the PreSonus / Fender Studio 1810c

description.p: A desktop mixer for the Studio 1810c audio interface on Linux. It speaks the vendor USB protocol to control the 18x10 routing matrix and the output faders that ALSA does not expose, plus the front-panel switches, while the kernel driver keeps streaming audio.
The window follows the layout of Universal Control on macOS and Windows: four input pairs, output rails and a master column, with the current clock and sample-rate status shown at all times.
Level meters are computed from the PipeWire or PulseAudio stream, because the interface's firmware does not report levels over USB — a limitation that is documented rather than hidden.
The routing matrix, faders, switches and clock status are hardware verified. No kernel patches and no firmware writes: the interface keeps working as an ordinary ALSA device the whole time.

description.p: Reset routing from the window, and a quiet launch on Wayland and X11.
